description: The doubled expansion satisfies the union of the two renamed theories exactly when the two specified one-relation expansions both satisfy the original theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.double_models_iff.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {n : ℕ} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (r s : (Fin n → M) → Prop) (T : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.extended L n).Theory) :
  M ⊨
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side false).onTheory T ∪
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BethDefinability.side true).onTheory T ↔
    M ⊨ T ∧ M ⊨ T
